title: Near you opens on a tab that has events instead of an empty Now

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/feed/planner.tsx','utf8');const r=fs.readFileSync('lib/feed/home-rank.ts','utf8');const miss=[[/export function firstSlotWith/.test(r),'firstSlotWith helper'],[/useState<HomeSlot>\(\s*\(\) =>\s*firstSlotWith/.test(p),'planner opens on the first tab with results'],[/Show \{SLOTS/.test(p),'empty tab points at the next tab']].filter(([ok])=>!ok).map(([,m])=>m);if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-1157: '+miss.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Owner report 2026-10-20 (Android, Feed): Near you said Nothing that fits within 5 mi on Now with Anything selected while 27 public events with coordinates sit in the next week around North County. Production data and distance math are fine. Cause: Now only holds events live or starting within two hours (slotFor), it is the default tab, and its empty state told the member to widen the radius. At 10:46 Pacific nothing was left today, so the first screen read as no events nearby. Fix: open on the first tab with a result inside the radius, and when a tab is empty and a later tab has results, say so and offer one tap to it.
